text:
jamie: FYI we opened a limited HU200 burst pool in sa-east1 (So Paulo) and ca-tor1 (Toronto) for Dedicated customers. Live now, small capacity to start.

kai: Config: 8 GPUs / zone, 2 zones per region. Burst window 05:00-21:00 local. Non-guaranteed, will preempt for reservations.

infra-bot: infra-provision job #p-4921 -> COMPLETED :white_check_mark: (hu200 pools provisioned)

maria: Customer-facing notes: mark these as "burst" in the Console UI. Billing tag = dedicated.burst.hu200. We are capping org usage at 60 GPU-hours/day during ramp.

kai: Recommendations for teams: use region fallback and set request priority. Example snippet for routing: 
```
routing:
  prefer: sa-east1
  fallbacks: [ca-tor1, mi300-eu]
  priority: low
```

sales-lead: Heads-up for AMs  we will proactively contact customers who sustain >cap usage and offer reserved migration.

maria: Ops will run a smoke test tomorrow 07:00 PT that might cause short spikes. Expect brief increased 502/503s.

jamie: Action items: product teams validate fallback by EOD Friday. Eng-infra monitor preempt_rate and egress. Ping me with any anomalies. :rocket:
